messages:
emma: Pen test kickoff — external assessor arrives 2026-04-02. Scope: KMS integrations (KMS proxy + key wrapping), RBAC changes for assessor roles, audit logging across private + dedicated clusters. Need remediation tracker, evidence packaging, log snapshots, and a retest window. Who can own evidence packaging?

raj: I can own the remediation tracker. Will create JIRA SEC-523 and add a short triage checklist. ETA EOD today.

marta: I'll handle log exports and retention. Which clusters do we snapshot? prod-inference and staging-private sound right?

oliver: I'll own the KMS access window & ephemeral role mapping. Quick question: can we provision an assumable role with read-only KMS metadata access? Assessor should NOT get DECRYPT permissions.

emma: Correct — no DECRYPT. We need audit logs for KMS API calls and KMS-proxy access logs. Marta, please preserve CloudTrail + proxy logs starting 24h before the test window and keep until retest.

marta: Noted. I'll export to s3://redwood-sec-evidence/pen-tests/2026-04-02/ and set lifecycle 180d. Will post presigned URLs when ready.

raj: Tracker columns: ticket, owner, remediation summary, evidence link, verification notes, status, RBAC-diff, KMS-config-snapshot. Adding these now.

oliver: For ephemeral roles: propose 4-hour windows, OIDC short-lived tokens, unique session names per assessor. Any objections?

alex: No objections. Oncall will rotate service account keys after the access window. Also recommend enabling elevated audit level for kms-proxy + inference-gateway during the window.

marta: Debug-level logs = more noise and cost. We'll enable debug only on kms-proxy and inference-gateway and limit retention for debug artifacts. We'll snapshot only those two services.

sec-assessor: We need a test account to validate RBAC. Please create assessor-readonly@redwood-sec and map it to the ephemeral role mapping you plan to use.

sre-oncall-bot: deploy job #deploy-782 started: creating snapshot for prod-inference logs -> s3://redwood-sec-evidence/pen-tests/2026-04-02/snapshots/prod-inference-2026-04-02-01.tar.gz

emma: Retest proposal: 2026-04-09 through 2026-04-11. If remediations land earlier and we can verify, we can move the retest up. All artifacts and evidence should be tagged SEC-523.

raj: Scheduling a 30m triage on 2026-04-03 10:00 PT to review initial findings and assign fixes. I'll attach the tracker link in the calendar.

emma: Owners for the runbook: raj (tracker), marta (logs/evidence), oliver (KMS & roles), alex (service account rotation/oncall). I'll update the intake doc and loop in Legal for NDA confirmation.

marta: FYI — I'll also snapshot KMS-proxy config and include `kubectl get configmap kms-proxy-config -o yaml` output in the evidence bundle.

oliver: One more note: please avoid sharing plaintext keys in evidence. If verifiers need to validate key usage, provide KMS usage logs + encrypted ciphertext samples and the key metadata only.

emma: Agreed. Thanks everyone — tagging next steps in SEC-523. Ping here for any blockers. :thumbsup:
